subject: SkyBridge technical demo + security & procurement coordination
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
To: Eric Shaw <eric.shaw@skybridge.com>, Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@skybridge.com>
Cc: security team <sec-team@skybridge.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: SkyBridge technical demo + security & procurement coordination

Hi Eric / Alice —

Thanks again for the time on the discovery call last week. We'd like to schedule a 60–75 minute technical demo with our Solutions Engineering team to walk through integration patterns, latency/cost expectations, and the security checklist you flagged.

Quick asks so we land on the right slate:
- Who should join from SkyBridge (platform engineers + security + procurement)?
- Any strict blackout windows on Jun 28–30?
- Do you want the SE demo to include an anonymized data flow and a short run of a sandbox account?

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Mon Jun 28 — 10:00–11:15
- Mon Jun 28 — 14:00–15:15
- Tue Jun 29 — 09:00–10:15

I’ll loop in Marcus (SE) and Priyom (SE) on the next note so they can confirm availability and the agenda. Attached is a short demo agenda we typically use.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference
Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (pdf)
From: Eric Shaw <eric.shaw@skybridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Cc: Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@skybridge.com>, security team <sec-team@skybridge.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyBridge technical demo + security & procurement coordination

Thanks Vanessa —

We want the following people on the demo: myself (platform), Nisha Kapoor (software eng lead), plus one security rep — forwarding to sec-team for that. Procurement (Alice) will probably not attend the demo but will join a short contract/timeline sync afterwards.

Blackout: Jun 28 after 15:00 PT is tough because of our release window. The suggested morning slot on Jun 28 (10:00) looks promising for the engineers. If you can include a security touchpoint at the end of the demo (15–20 minutes), that would be ideal.

Also: we need to verify that no customer data will be ingested into Redwood's hosted demo environment — sandbox only.

—Eric
Eric Shaw
Senior Platform Engineer | SkyBridge Financial

10:00–11:15 PT on Mon Jun 28 works for me. Priyom — can you cover the live sandbox steps? I’ll prepare a short performance snapshot tied to the kinds of inference loads you described in the discovery (50–200 qps, p99 latency targets).

Notes for the team:
- We will use a fully isolated demo sandbox; no customer data will be ingested.
- To make the sandbox useful for SkyBridge, please send a small sample schema (not data) and one or two representative prompt templates by EOD Mon (vanessa will coordinate).
- Security: attaching a short checklist we run through during the Q&A. Also happy to schedule a separate 30-min security deep-dive if your security team wants more detail.

Attachment: security-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
